title: Application Software Company Equity Stake For Sale in Athens, Greece
tagline: Operates a cloud-based software business in Greece, providing digital invoicing, business administration, and regulatory compliance solutions for Greek SMEs, freelancers, and enterprise partners. - Offers three cloud platforms covering daily invoice issuance and myDATA compliance, employee management through the mandatory Digital Work Card under ERGANI, and customer management with automated myDATA compliance. - Provides REST API solutions that enable software providers, enterprise partners, and financial institutions to integrate myDATA and ERGANI compliance capabilities into their own systems through white-label integrations. - Serves over 400 Greek SMEs, freelancers, and enterprise partners across various sectors through direct subscriptions and business-to-business integrations. - Generates recurring subscription revenue from its cloud platforms and B2B revenue through wholesale licensing, API usage, and bulk-volume agreements. - Maintains integrations with AADE-certified e-invoicing providers, including Ilyda, as well as banking APIs such as Piraeus Bank rAPId for transaction retrieval and automated bank reconciliation. - Connects with payment infrastructure providers, including Viva Wallet, ePay, E-Paroxos, and Bratnet, supporting integrations across invoicing, payments, and financial workflows. - Supports customers through direct access to its cloud applications and provides technical and commercial assistance to partners integrating its APIs. - Is led by a team with over 15 years of combined experience in Greek tax regulations, cloud architecture, and financial software development. Additionally, hires contractual employees to support operations. - Holds VAT registration. - Has established a technology and integration ecosystem serving businesses that need reliable digital administration and regulatory compliance infrastructure in the Greek market.
